notes: Complete list: 42 actions (src/actions/*.ts: audio, media, outputs, scenes, sources, transitions, ui-config-custom) and 36 feedbacks (src/feedbacks/*.ts), merged by spreading the get*Actions/get*Feedbacks functions in src/actions.ts and src/feedbacks.ts. Nothing is registered anywhere else (main.ts calls setActionDefinitions/setFeedbackDefinitions with exactly these results). Extracted statically with the TypeScript compiler API, which resolved the shared helpers (choiceDropdown, choiceMultiDropdown, targetDropdown, modeDropdown, modeNumber, outputControlAction, AUDIO_TRACK_CHOICES, constants). Variables and presets are not catalogued.
Protocol: obs-websocket v5 through obs-websocket-js 5.0.8. Connection settings (src/config.ts): host, port (default "4455"), password, and scheme ("ws" default, or "wss").

Built on @companion-module/base ~2.1.3: option values may be expressions, except where the module sets disableAutoExpression (recorded per option). visibleWhen holds the source isVisibleExpression text, informational only.

Dynamic dropdowns (scene, source, filter, transition, profile, scene collection, output, hotkey, display, image format) are built from OBS state by choiceDropdown in src/actions/options.ts and carry choicesNote plus valueType. The helper sets allowCustom: true unless the call passes allowCustom: false (the transition lists in quick_transition, transition_type and the take_screenshot format list); the catalog records allowCustom only where it is true. The default of such a dropdown is the first entry of the list at runtime (described in choicesNote, not stored as default); only output (virtualcam_output), display (0) and format (png) have fixed defaults from src/actions/options.ts. Lists are empty until OBS has connected.

Several actions have fields that are only used in some modes; they are all listed with visibleWhen (for example volume value/duration are shown for mode set and amount for mode adjust). Number fields built with modeNumber and most other number fields set clampValues: true in the source; the schema has no field for it, min and max are recorded.

Not represented because the schema has no field: clampValues, sortSelection (multidropdown), enableAlpha and returnType (colorpicker fields use enableAlpha: true and returnType: string, so values are CSS colour strings), feedback defaultStyle, learn callbacks (many actions can learn from OBS state) and hasResult (mute, recording, streaming, replay_buffer, output, studio_mode, take_screenshot, custom_command and vendorRequest return a result). A field tooltip is recorded in description (set_audio_tracks tracks, audioPeaking peakHold).

Several numeric-looking options are text inputs with useVariables and are parsed by the callback (setTextProperties fontSize, outlineSize, backgroundOpacity, extentsWidth, extentsHeight; source_properties positionX/positionY/scaleX/scaleY/rotation); an empty value is skipped. The setTextProperties props list selects which of the other fields are applied; fields for properties outside the chosen list are ignored. Some properties only apply to GDI+ text sources (descriptions say so), dropShadow only to FreeType sources.

Dropdown ids keep their source types: setTextProperties textTransform uses numeric ids 0 to 3, the display dropdown uses numeric monitor indexes, everything else uses strings (including the "true"/"false"/"toggle" ids of mute, visibility, monitoring and studio mode, and the track ids "1" to "6").

custom_command and vendorRequest send arbitrary obs-websocket requests (JSON in a text field) and can trigger anything OBS or a vendor plugin accepts; set_stream_settings changes stream service settings and key (ignored while streaming).

Defaults copied as written: vendorEvent uses example values (downstream-keyer, dsk_scene_changed, new_scene, Scene 1); custom_command default request is SetCurrentProgramScene with {"sceneName": "Scene 1"}; trigger-hotkey-sequence keyId default is OBS_KEY_NONE. streamCongestionAbove default is Math.round(CONGESTION_MEDIOCRE * 100) = 67 (src/constants.ts, 2/3). preview_scene mode next looks up sceneIndex - 1 and previous sceneIndex + 1 (src/actions/scenes.ts:47-49), as written in the source.

Not tested against a running OBS or Companion instance. 12 entries (actions media_control, volume, recording, set_audio_tracks, take_screenshot, open_projector, setTextProperties; feedbacks streamCongestionAbove, audioPeaking, vendorEvent, scene_item_active_in_scene, freeDiskSpaceRemaining) were compared with the source by hand, including provenance lines.
